name: Majestic
summary: Majestic link intelligence: Trust Flow, Citation Flow, backlinks, referring domains, anchors and top pages.

api_key.description: a Majestic API key (enable it from the API tab on majestic.com)

notes: Every command is a GET to /api/json with cmd naming the command; /api/xml answers XML instead. Majestic itself advises POST over GET for production use.
Costs are in three allowances: Analysis units, Retrieval units (one per row returned) and Index Item units (GetIndexItemInfo only). Each endpoint note says what it spends.
Set datasource to fresh or historic. The developer sandbox host (developer.majestic.com) returns a reduced dataset at no charge, but this entry targets the live host.
Responses carry Code and ErrorMessage fields; check them as well as the HTTP status.

endpoints.name: Get subscription info
endpoints.summary: Your subscriptions with remaining Analysis, Retrieval and Index Item units, plan names and index details.

cmd.description: The command name. Always GetSubscriptionInfo for this call.

datasource.description: Index to query: historic (default when your plan includes it) or fresh. Majestic advises always setting it.

notes: Uses no units. Check this before large pulls.

endpoints.name: Index item info
endpoints.summary: Trust Flow, Citation Flow, backlink and referring-domain counts and topics for up to 100 domains, subdomains or URLs.

cmd.description: The command name. Always GetIndexItemInfo for this call.

datasource.description: Index to query: historic (default when your plan includes it) or fresh. Majestic advises always setting it.

items.description: How many item0..itemN parameters this call carries, 1 to 100. Items past item0 need a raw call.

item0.description: A root domain, subdomain or exact URL.

DesiredTopics.description: Number of Trust Flow topics returned (default 3; at most 30 for domains, 20 for subdomains, 10 for URLs).

AddAllTopics.description: 1 adds a TrustCategories column with the topic split.

EnableResourceUnitFailover.description: 1 spends Analysis and Retrieval units once Index Item units run out (500 Analysis units per call plus 50 per item, and 1 Retrieval unit per item). Default 0.

notes: Spends one Index Item unit per item queried.
URLs with very few external backlinks may return estimates, flagged by Status MayExist.

endpoints.name: Get backlink data
endpoints.summary: Backlinks to a domain, subdomain or URL with source, target, anchor, flags and dates.

cmd.description: The command name. Always GetBackLinkData for this call.

datasource.description: Index to query: historic (default when your plan includes it) or fresh. Majestic advises always setting it.

item.description: The URL, domain or subdomain to return backlinks for.

Count.description: Number of backlinks to return. Default 100, maximum 50000.

From.description: Result position to start from (0 is the first); use it to page.

Mode.description: 0 (default) returns top links including deleted ones; 1 removes deleted links.

ShowDomainInfo.description: 1 adds a data table about the referring domains. Default 0.

MaxSourceURLsPerRefDomain.description: -1 (default), 1, 3 or 10: cap on source URLs taken from any one referring domain.

notes: Costs 5000 Analysis units per call (more when sorting or filtering), plus one Retrieval unit per row returned.
Does not return links flagged as alt text.

endpoints.name: Get referring domains
endpoints.summary: Referring domains for a domain, subdomain or URL with Trust Flow, Citation Flow, link counts and crawl dates.

cmd.description: The command name. Always GetRefDomains for this call.

datasource.description: Index to query: historic (default when your plan includes it) or fresh. Majestic advises always setting it.

item0.description: A URL, subdomain or root domain.

AnalysisDepth.description: Most referring domains considered per root domain queried. Default 10000, maximum 100000.

MinMatchesRequired.description: Minimum matches a domain needs when several items are queried. Default 1.

OrderBy1.description: Primary sort column, 0-18 (0 matches, 1 Alexa rank, 12 Citation Flow, 13 Trust Flow, and so on; see the docs page).

OrderBy2.description: Secondary sort column, same values as OrderBy1.

UsePrefixScan.description: 1 enables prefix mode, like the Path (URL*) option in Site Explorer.

notes: Costs 1000 Analysis units per call plus one Retrieval unit per row.

endpoints.name: Get anchor text
endpoints.summary: Anchor text statistics for a target, or the referring domains and backlinks behind one anchor.

cmd.description: The command name. Always GetAnchorText for this call.

datasource.description: Index to query: historic (default when your plan includes it) or fresh. Majestic advises always setting it.

item.description: The URL, subdomain or domain to query.

TextMode.description: 0 (default) returns anchors lowercased as found; 1 strips punctuation and delimiters.

Mode.description: 0 (default) aggregated anchor stats; 1 referring domains for an exact anchor; 2 backlinks for an anchor (needs CanReturnURLs earlier).

FilterAnchorText.description: Anchor text to filter by, used with FilterAnchorTextMode.

FilterAnchorTextMode.description: 0 (default) no filter, 1 exact match, 2 anchors containing the text.

FilterRefDomain.description: With backlinks returned for one referring domain, that domain.

from.description: First result to return, for paging.

notes: Costs 1000 Analysis units per call plus one Retrieval unit per row.

endpoints.name: Get top pages
endpoints.summary: The best pages on a root domain or subdomain by backlinks, or a check that one URL is in the index.

cmd.description: The command name. Always GetTopPages for this call.

datasource.description: Index to query: historic (default when your plan includes it) or fresh. Majestic advises always setting it.

Query.description: A root domain, subdomain or one URL.

StartDoc.description: Item to start from; defaults to 0.

notes: Costs 5000 Analysis units per call plus one Retrieval unit per row.
The only guaranteed way to check whether a URL is in the index.
